title: Copper tubing joints.
officialText:
Copper tubing joints shall be brazed in accordance with Section 1203.3.
1209.4Not embedded related piping. Joints of other piping in cavities or running exposed shall be joined in accordance with
manufacturer’s installation instructions and related sections of this code.
